sources.title: brayniac/OpenLlama-3B-v2-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: In this repo, we present a permissively licensed open source reproduction of Meta AI's LLaMA large language model. We are releasing a series of 3B, 7B and 13B models trained on 1T tokens. We provide PyTorch and JAX weights of pre-trained OpenLLaMA models, as well as evaluation results and comparison against the original LLaMA models.
